title: [master]-Edit in Excel fails with false duplicate error when creating new Item Variants
summary: Item Variants page no longer fails with a false duplicate key error when creating new variants through Edit in Excel by limiting the forced record update to interactive clients only.
key_points: Removed forced immediate record persistence that triggered during Edit in Excel operations
Scoped the OnValidate trigger's CurrPage.Update(true) call to interactive sessions only
OData and web service sessions now bypass the early update, preventing duplicate key conflicts
Allows Edit in Excel to handle variant creation through its normal OData insert flow
quote: Scope the forced update so it runs only for interactive clients and is skipped for OData/web-service sessions.
